metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 128 channels at a sampling rate of 1024 Hz (2048 Hz for a subset of participants), inside a Faraday cage under dim lighting (120-150 lux). Participants completed four consecutive 5-minute runs alternating between eyes-open and eyes-closed conditions, with run order randomized across two possible sequences. During the eyes-open condition, participants fixated on a black point on a white wall. No preprocessing was applied prior to sharing, only conversion from .bdf to BIDS format.
